en: A multi‑view black‑and‑white postcard showing various landmarks of Budapest. The images include the Fisherman's Bastion, Gellért Hill with the Gellért monument and colonnade, the Castle Garden Bazaar and a monument, Matthias Church and its stairs, several bridges over the Danube such as Margaret Bridge and Franz Joseph Bridge, and an equestrian statue. Captions are printed in German and Hungarian Gothic-style script under each vignette.
